why_best: This approach injects immediate, real-time urgency and OS-level realism into the scene without breaking the viewer's focus on the main data landscape.
why_bad: A full-screen modal or intrusive panel swap would completely shatter the illusion of a live ambient monitor and force a jarring break in telemetry continuity.
trap: A near-miss will feel like a generic web toast element rather than a pixel-perfect, platform-native system signal with tactile physical credibility.
